subject.title: feat(android): add Skill Workshop settings panel

question: Should Android expose a Skill Workshop Quarantine action before the quarantined-proposal recovery contract in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/101657 is resolved?
rationale: Quarantine has safety and lifecycle meaning beyond ordinary proposal dismissal, and current main has an open maintainer-decision issue showing quarantined proposals become stuck.

options.title: Defer Android quarantine
options.body: Remove or hide the Android Quarantine button for this PR and keep the mobile panel aligned with current Web/iOS apply/reject behavior until recovery semantics land.

options.title: Merge with accepted dead-end risk
options.body: Allow Android users to quarantine proposals now, accepting that they may need workaround/recreation until the recovery issue is resolved.

options.title: Block on lifecycle recovery
options.body: Hold this PR until the service, CLI, Gateway, and UI recovery path for quarantined proposals is designed and implemented.

recommendation.title: Defer Android quarantine
recommendation.body: Remove or hide the Android Quarantine button for this PR and keep the mobile panel aligned with current Web/iOS apply/reject behavior until recovery semantics land.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the strongest history signal for the Skill Workshop lifecycle and UI action semantics affected by the decision.
